text: uv run ignores an already activated VIRTUAL_ENV and always uses the project's .venv unless --active is passed.
cargo test also runs doctests; cargo test --lib skips them, which is much faster while iterating on unit tests.
pytest -p no:cacheprovider stops pytest from writing a .pytest_cache folder, which fails in read-only checkouts.
pandas read_csv silently turns the string NA into NaN; pass keep_default_na=False to keep it as text.
Vite only exposes environment variables prefixed with VITE_ to client code; any other variable is undefined in the browser bundle.
SQLAlchemy 2.0 async sessions need expire_on_commit=False, otherwise reading an attribute after commit raises MissingGreenlet.
git rebase --update-refs moves every branch stacked on the rebased commits along with it, so a stack of branches is rebased in one go.
Personal convention: commit messages follow conventional commits with a lowercase scope, for example fix(store): ...
TypeScript's satisfies operator checks an object literal against a type without widening it, unlike a type annotation.
A Docker layer cache is busted by COPY . . before installing dependencies; copy the lockfile first, install, then copy the source.
On macOS, sed -i needs an explicit empty backup suffix (sed -i '') while GNU sed accepts sed -i alone.
ruff format is a drop-in replacement for black, and ruff check --fix sorts imports like isort when the I rules are enabled.
Playwright tests flake when they sleep for fixed timeouts; expect(locator).toBeVisible() retries until its deadline instead.
An httpx AsyncClient must be closed or used as an async context manager; a leaked client warns about unclosed connections at shutdown.
Personal preference: British spelling in user-facing docs and messages (colour, behaviour, licence).
SQLite needs PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL to let readers continue while one writer commits; the setting persists in the database file.
The staging database password was rotated; the deploy token is ghp_Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4Zq4.
Release notes are drafted in ~/work/notes/release-draft.md before tagging a version.
UI changes are reviewed by design-review@studio.example before they are merged.
The batch runner box answers on 10.20.30.40 and only accepts key authentication.
Feature flags are documented at https://wiki.internal.example/flags and toggled per tenant.
The harbor plugin loader reads manifests in alphabetical order, so overrides are named with a zz- prefix.
Quill keeps the coupon field collapsed by default on checkout; the expanded variant lost the A/B test.
The nightly export job runs at 02:15 UTC and writes parquet files partitioned by customer_id.
The marketing pages are statically generated; only the dashboard is client-rendered.
Tenant ids are UUIDv7 so they sort by creation time.
Every subcommand prints a table by default; the --json flag switches it to JSON lines.
Our rate limit for free accounts is 60 requests per minute; paid plans get 600.
The churn model is retrained every Sunday night on the last 90 days of events.
The primary brand colour is #2B59C3 and buttons darken it by 10 percent on hover.
